newsitem.title: UK: IPE NATURAL GAS WEAKER, SEPT BREAKS BELOW 9 PENCE.
newsitem.headline: IPE NATURAL GAS WEAKER, SEPT BREAKS BELOW 9 PENCE.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were weaker on Wednesday, with the key trades of the day on the front full month September, which broke through key psychological support at nine pence a therm.
A total of 55 lots were traded on September, with the last trade done at 8.85 pence, 0.150 pence down on Tuesday's settlement.
Bearish sentiment on September helped push down spot prices across the forward curve on Tuesday.
"It ended on nine last night but I don't think people saw any reason for it to correct back up again. It's been sold quite aggressively," said one broker.
October was the only other month to have traded by 1204 GMT. Five lots traded at 10.65 pence, a fall of 0.10 pence.
Balance of month gas was bid lower at 8.85 but no offer was posted.
Other months were bid and offered at mostly weaker numbers.
